blocks.title: Ethical considerations in terms of use
blocks.text: Terms of use should be fair, transparent and respectful of users' rights: clear and straightforward, not overly complex or deceptive, and providers should make sure users understand what they agree to.

An online course in Pakistan should state clearly whether a certificate is given, how personal data are handled and whether there are extra fees; it is unethical to make a course look free when there are hidden costs.
